scope: Phone layouts below 640px; desktop tools preserved.
method: Active versions checked against Sleek. Actual route dispatch, enclosing shells and component structure reviewed for every screen; focused isolated checks plus selected full-view browser fixtures at 390px and 320px. Fixtures use example records and stub transport, not production transactions.
intentionalOverrides: White SOEICAM theme, actual logo and one account control.
Manual goods issuance with centralized stock; no per-product Receive/Count controls.
Quantity adjustments remain in Accounting with existing role restrictions.
Real records, permissions, approvals, identity verification and transaction validation take precedence over illustrative data and switches.
Recipe creation/version workflows hidden; assembly definitions/builds and batch/expiry tracking retained.

screens.name: Connexion
screens.route: /login; /register uses the same provider shell for signup
screens.mobileGate: Auth page outside ERP shell. Active auth provider determines actual form; authenticated staff role is resolved by existing account access, never by a role-picker shortcut.
before: Secure provider/legacy auth forms were connected but the full source login/reset composition was not implemented verbatim.
changes: White phone theme, SOEICAM logo and configured provider form retained; provider controls own identity verification and recovery.
limitations: Clerk-managed multi-step sign-in/recovery is an explicit adaptation of the source’s simultaneous static login/reset form.
No illustrative role-login shortcuts, fake remember-device state, or fixed 30-minute reset guarantee are added.

screens.name: Accueil GM
screens.mobileGate: usePhoneLayout() and ManagerHome section === overview; authenticated admin role and saved module permissions. Other GM sections retain their own workspaces.
before: The existing phone role shell added a colored bordered identity card before the Sleek body and rendered role before greeting/date.
GM body already had summary, module grid, alerts and primary sale action
changes: EmployeeDashboard phone home shell is now plain date, Bonjour/name and role, with one refresh action; inner staff dates are suppressed where the shared welcome already supplies the date.
Supplementary treasury and quick-report controls moved into Other tools, retaining the summary → modules → alerts → sale-action hierarchy.
Added actual overdue recurring-payable totals and separately labelled overdue charges not yet recognized, from the existing authorized recurring reader. Read-only previews skip finance reads.
limitations: No invented sample records or area names are inserted; inaccessible modules are omitted.
Management previews retain selection controls and a read-only notice beyond the reference composition.
Overdue alerts depend on configured recurring schedules and saved balances; overdue unrecognized charges are not claimed as posted expenses.

screens.name: Accueil Commercial
renderChain: src/views/EmployeeDashboard.jsx own commercial branch OR src/app/(erp)/commercial/page.jsx
screens.mobileGate: usePhoneLayout() and CommercialDashboard tab === home. CommercialWorkspace hides its old boxed mobile header only for own home; management reporting retains its existing controls.
before: The body sections existed but old connection/status/help wrapper preceded them.
Metrics were four separate cards and recent activity used independent bordered cards rather than source grouping.
changes: Plain date/greeting/role replaces the old own-home phone wrapper; desktop and management header stay available.
Record sale 56px, New customer 48px; one grouped two-by-two summary card with a lower divider; acquired customer queue and one divided recent-activity card.
Supplementary stock, supplies, returns, cash, commissions and central degustation functions remain in a 96px three-column module grid inside an accessible Modules disclosure.
Centralized inventory still routes sale creation through the existing own-stock sale handler.
limitations: Acquired customer rows use available real identity/zone data; source sample per-customer money figures are not fabricated.
Recent activity uses recorded sale dates/statuses; source sample times are not invented.
GM commercial preview deliberately renders CommercialActivityReport, with no employee sale/registration controls.

screens.name: Accueil Comptable
screens.mobileGate: usePhoneLayout() and OperationalStaffHome template === warehouse_manager. The historical warehouse_manager role key is the saved Accountant identity.
before: Four metrics, modules and task sections existed, but identity wrapper differed and tasks lacked the source-sized explicit row actions.
changes: Keeps source separate two-by-two metric cards, six main modules in three columns, real pending tasks with 48px View controls and 22px cards.
Shared phone welcome is date, Bonjour/name and role without the old colored border card.
Actual stock valuation reader and posted-ledger monthly net profit helper retained; payables/receivables remain unavailable when their readers are unavailable.
Other granted tools remain accessible in a disclosure.
Read-only management previews now skip the finance-summary request and suppress previously loaded finance values.
limitations: Pending rows come from actual expense/material-issue/risk queues; sample rent, handover and count discrepancy tasks are not inserted.
View opens the existing permitted workspace; it does not fabricate a direct processing operation.
No P&L derived from sales minus purchases and no depreciation sync writes are added.

screens.name: Accueil Production
screens.mobileGate: usePhoneLayout(). WorkspaceAccess filters every destination and preview disables operational navigation/actions.
before: Summary used separate small cards; the top role wrapper, 48px production action and always-visible supplementary grid differed from source geometry.
changes: One grouped three-column assemblies/month batches/recorded output summary, horizontal real material stock cards, recent batches, and 56px sticky Record production action.
Primary production links to /manufacturing?section=build, matching grouped assembly entry; recorded grouped builds remain ProductionOrder records in monthly counters.
Legacy /manufacturing/new Plan production and existing accounting, expenses, company sales, warehouse, delivery, approval and quality tools remain under Other tools.
Shared plain date/greeting/role header and 22px cards.
limitations: Recent batch rows show actual output/planned amounts and dates; source sample bucket/yield labels are not invented when absent from records.
Monthly output is from recorded ProductionOrder actual_output; unavailable monthly reader stays unavailable.
White SOEICAM styling intentionally replaces the source cream background.

screens.name: Accueil Caissier
screens.route: / for cashier; /team-workspaces?section=reports&role=cashier (read-only preview). /cashier is the separate Caisse screen.
renderChain: src/views/EmployeeDashboard.jsx own cashier branch OR LiveWorkspace cashier preview
screens.mobileGate: usePhoneLayout(); CashierWorkspace invokes renderHome only for home, keeping all actual receive/petty/resolve dialogs outside the mobile branch.
before: Own cashier home lacked date/greeting/role, primary actions were side by side, summary split into cards, and handover controls were smaller than source.
The callback home bypassed the existing date picker, refresh and loading/error presentation.
changes: Adds real cashier date, Bonjour/name and role, stacked 56px Receive cash followed by 48px Petty cash, grouped two-column summary, pending-handover avatar cards with 48px Discrepancy/Confirm controls.
Queue includes submitted/partially_received/disputed handovers, excluding already received documents.
Three main modules match source; Daily savings, Approved payments and Cheques & signatures remain under Other tools.
Cash desk date/refresh controls retained in compact overflow tools; existing errors and initial loading are shown. Procurement owner extended callback payload for these values.
limitations: The second quick report opens existing Customer invoices, rather than inventing a new daily-credit query.
Historical source dates can be selected through the existing callback; Confirmed today refers to the active cash activity date.
Cash management preview leaves operational controls disabled. Default /cashier Caisse composition is separately owned by procurement agent.

screens.name: Accueil Hôtesse
screens.route: / for hotesse; /outlet-reports for own Hotesse reporting; /team-workspaces?section=reports&role=hotesse&employee=<id> for read-only preview
screens.mobileGate: usePhoneLayout() and HotesseWorkspace tab === home. Alternate /outlet-reports now uses HotesseHome instead of bypassing its mobile branch.
before: Own home body existed with nested customer cards and a smaller report action.
Alternate /outlet-reports still mounted the legacy home directly, so the actual reporting navigation did not show the exported mobile home.
changes: Consistent plain date/greeting/role, no-sale scope notice, separate real report counters, 56px New visit report action, one divided assigned-customer card and source three-module grid.
Shelf stock, supplies/batches and performance functions remain in Other tools; actual customer map links and map drawer stay available.
HotesseLiveWorkspace now renders HotesseHome with real identity and its unchanged load/refresh/error/submit handlers; desktop still renders the legacy workspace.
limitations: The ERP records reports, not scheduled visit appointments; counters say Reports today and no example visit times are fabricated.
New visit report opens existing assigned outlet report task; existing stock snapshots and closing-report validations still apply.

screens.name: Ventes
before: Confirmed matches: quick Today/Week/Month periods, receipt/customer/employee search, All/Sales/Exchanges segmented counts, two metrics, date-grouped receipt cards and real detail navigation. Confirmed mismatches: Sales.jsx still prepends the legacy PageHeader with a back-to-menu control and a separate New sale button row; the reference has a single Ventes title/calendar header. The calendar is instead placed beside the overview line, and that line lacks the reference rounded bordered overview banner. Receipt cards use generic Receipt/Rotate icons instead of real product thumbnails and min-h-24 (96px) instead of the reference compact min-h-16 layout. Cards omit time and credit due-date text, with uniform status styling; invoice rows display invoice document numbers rather than consistently the original receipt reference. The floating plus is the global multi-action menu rather than a direct New sale action. Extra Refresh, detailed-report link and Dégustations button remain after the list.
changes: Removed the phone legacy Sales PageHeader/back/New-sale row; restored local title/calendar header and rounded overview banner.
Added a direct New sale FAB with data-mobile-action-bar to suppress the global plus menu.
Moved refresh, detailed reports, history and the full Sales menu into an explicit Sales tools disclosure.
Compacted record cards; invoice detail links now carry from=sales to return to the originating register.

Phone-only metadata enrichment adds the first recorded sold product and current permitted image, saved outstanding-credit due date and validated recorded timestamp. Enrichment is bounded to journal-verified display rows; summary readers keep their existing queries.
limitations: Missing/deleted product images retain a placeholder/name fallback; absent or invalid timestamps and unsaved due dates display a dash.
Current true metrics remain Cash at sale and Customer balances, not cashier-confirmed deposits today.
Global SOEICAM brand/account shell and role-based bottom navigation remain an app integration adaptation.

screens.name: Nouvelle vente 1/3
before: Confirmed matches: back/title/subtitle/1-of-3 header, thin three-segment progress, selected-customer card, conditional destination, date and locked stock source, searchable permitted-seller radios, fixed Next button. Confirmed mismatches: customer search is hidden in the legacy CustomerPicker dialog behind a large Choose customer trigger rather than the inline 48px search. After selection, both the picker trigger and a selected-customer card repeat the same customer. The selected card shows phone/address rather than the assigned-agent/neighborhood secondary line. Seller rows omit real role metadata and the reference unauthorized/disabled-person explanation. The footer adds product-count and 0-XAF total even at customer step; the reference footer contains Next only. Primary action is 48px rather than reference 56px. The global bottom nav below it moves the footer up 64px compared with the reference full-bottom action.
changes: Replaced the legacy customer dialog trigger with inline searchable customer choices, preserving customer/branch validation and resetting replacements on customer change.
Removed the repeated picker card; selected card now uses real assigned-agent/location fields when supplied, otherwise truthful contact fallback.
Kept searchable authorized seller radio rows, with real role metadata when supplied; self-only staff remain readonly.
Step-one footer now contains only a 56px Next action.
limitations: Authorized employee catalogue does not include disabled unauthorized staff or their client counts; these are not invented.
Branch remains mandatory when actual delivery destinations exist; manager attribution remains server-authorized.
Persistent app brand shell/bottom navigation differs from the local-reference-only form shell.

screens.name: Nouvelle vente 2/3
before: Confirmed matches: step header/progress, selected-customer strip, Sale/Replacement/Dégustation tabs, real product pictures, price, available quantity, editable quantity, total and Next. Confirmed mismatches: reference product cards have a 64px image, size/flavor metadata, availability badge, and large minus/input/plus controls beneath product info; implementation has a 52px image and a lone right-side 80px number input, no +/- controls or availability badge. Extra stock-source controls, refresh/help, product search and price/discount disclosures change the hierarchy. The reference replacement-only switch below products is absent; replacement-only mode is inferred from lines/replacements in the existing separate tab. Dégustation tab is an information card opening the existing separate dialog, with no in-flow selected tasting count. Footer counts selected product lines (not total article quantity), omits tasting count, and remains above the global nav. Selected product price/discount disclosure adds row height.
changes: Restored 64px real product image, size/flavor metadata, availability badge and large minus/direct-input/plus controls; direct decimal quantity entry remains available.
Added accessible tab labels and accurate total article quantity in the footer.
Moved stock-source help/refresh into a disclosure that opens when stock is unavailable or errors; validations remain active.
Added clear replacement-only entry using existing replacement evidence controls; with paid quantities still present, it explicitly says to clear them for an exchange-only receipt.
Dégustation remains a visibly separate verified transaction.
limitations: Intentional transaction adaptation: Dégustation is separately posted, never combined into sale confirmation or falsely counted as a draft sale item.
Replacement declaration and damaged/expired/lot evidence remain in existing verified form instead of a decorative mode switch that could discard sale quantities.
Stock tools and product search/price-discount disclosures preserve app features beyond the static design.
The full-width product control row wraps safely on narrow phones rather than forcing the 390px reference dimensions.

screens.name: Nouvelle vente 3/3
before: Confirmed matches: payment-step header/progress, customer/product summary, attributed seller, mandatory real receipt reference, cash/credit choice, replacement summary and confirm-total action. Confirmed mismatches: payment choices are bare side-by-side buttons instead of the reference stacked full-width radio cards with cash-handover explanation and credit due-date line. Seller is a plain text card plus Edit salesperson link, rather than the compact selector with authorization explanation; the link appears even when canChooseSeller=false. Receipt field lacks the reference paper-receipt-book helper. The Exchanges and tasting combined card is replaced by Exchanges only, so no tasting status appears. The separate Total of sale summary panel is missing; total appears in footer count row and again in confirm button. Body review text uses smaller 12px lines, and fixed primary action is 48px instead of 56px, above persistent navigation.
changes: Replaced bare side-by-side payment buttons with stacked descriptive radio cards, cashier-handover explanation and real customer payment terms.
Seller edit link appears only when canChooseSeller; profile/permission explanation is explicit.
Added mandatory paper-receipt-book helper, truthful separate-Dégustation status, and Total of sale panel.
Kept notes/tax details in disclosure and changed final action to 56px, preserving the existing atomic save, retry key and validation.
limitations: Credit displays actual configured payment-term days rather than an invented saved due date.
Dégustation summary explicitly states it is a separate transaction; there is no false combined giveaway payload.
Cash handover is explained as pending confirmation; no unverified paid/cashier-confirmed state is asserted.
Global shell/bottom navigation remains an intentional app integration difference.

screens.name: Détail vente
before: Confirmed matches: both mobile detail components have local back/reference-date/status header, customer card, item/quantity/price totals and tracking. Confirmed mismatches by actual route: Sales register normally opens Invoice rows at /sales/invoices/:id. MobileInvoiceDetail shows invoice number rather than original receipt reference, generic Receipt icons rather than product thumbnails, no Exchanges section, and Tracking is balance/due/reference/tax instead of seller/recorded-by/cash-handover. The invoice branch has the 3 action buttons but all outline, and labels Print/PDF, Share/copy, Download invoice; Download saves an HTML invoice, not a PDF action. Back always routes to the invoice-management tab rather than returning to the sales register. At /sales/:id, MobileSaleDetail has product thumbnails, Exchanges and seller/recorded-by fields when present, but no confirmed cash-handover state/time, no 3 Print/Share/PDF action row; it exposes the generic ReportExport controls and an Open invoice button instead. Both branches omit receipt time and the customer confirmed-by-cashier state. Extra invoice tools/preview, collect and reversal features are disclosed below the main detail.
changes: Created MobileSaleReceipt.jsx shared receipt hierarchy for invoice, locked order and exchange routes: reference/status/date, customer, real product images/fallback, item totals, Exchanges, truthful tracking and consistent three-action row.

Order/exchange Print and Export PDF use the existing report print pipeline/browser print dialog; Share uses native navigator.share or clipboard fallback, with visible errors. No invoice is automatically created or issued.

Invoice keeps existing verified print/share handlers; Export PDF opens its existing printable invoice. HTML download, customization, Excel, invoice preview, collection and reversal remain in Invoice tools & preview.

Extended only invoiceDetail read projection with already saved receipt_reference/salesperson_name/stored recorder name, InvoiceLine product_id and whitelisted linked-source replacements; no cost/private IDs returned. Rejects cross-customer or conflicting linked-invoice source.
Mobile invoice return from Sales register now returns to /sales?tab=all; cashier retains own invoice-list return.
Authorized invoice detail now projects current product images and validated saved recorded timestamps; shared receipts use those fields without inferring transaction times.
limitations: Confirmed cash-handover time/status is not inferred from invoice or sale dates.
Recorder name appears only when a saved name snapshot exists; missing historical timestamps remain a dash.
Locked-order/exchange images use saved data/name fallbacks where the existing reader supplies no custom image.
Export PDF remains browser Print/Save PDF; the existing HTML download stays truthfully labelled.
Order, invoice and exchange keep their actual document statuses.

screens.name: Clients
before: The phone admin/employee route does render the new list directly, with real location chips, agent initials, balances and branch toggles. However, the enclosing generic PageHeader still stacks Map and Add customer on a second full-width row instead of the export's single title-and-two-icon header. CustomerQuickList renders one continuous bordered list with square avatars, rather than separate rounded customer cards with circular avatars. More materially, the admin search does not include acquired_by_name even though the export explicitly searches name/agent/zone. The commercial role branches to CustomerTasks rather than CustomerDirectory, retaining its old padded header, information popover, full Map button and select-based zone toolbar; it only inherits the redesigned row component.
changes: Added customer-specific MobileCustomerHeader and wired full directory routes for admin/employee and commercial.
Replaced phone continuous list borders with separate rounded cards and circular avatars; desktop row styling remains.
Changed administrative chips from neighbourhood labels to saved delivery zones, with All/Unassigned and query error recovery.
Included acquired_by_name and real zone names in administrative search; commercial data remains from fieldCustomers.
limitations: Phone layout applies at max-width 639px; existing tablet/desktop layouts remain.
Locate controls appear only for actual saved GPS. Customer names and balances remain ERP data.
Commercial fieldCustomers intentionally omits account balances, so its cards do not invent a balance.

screens.name: Fiche client
before: MobileCustomerOverview supplies the broad metric/contact/owner/branches/history hierarchy, but PartnerDetail inserts it above the entire old phone surface: CustomerActionGrid, payment/opening summaries, Overview/Stock & Expiry/Sales tabs, another PartnerGroupPanel and spoilage sections remain appended. This is a composed new-plus-old screen, not the export's coherent profile. The header lacks the parent/branch + area subtitle. The first card is Delivered Value across at most 200 recent orders, not current-month sales. The owner card falls back to the registrar but still labels that person Acquired by. Recent sales includes all SalesOrders, including drafts/cancelled states, rather than only actual posted sales. Branch rows omit direct locate buttons and last-sale dates. The commercial role bypasses this component completely and displays the old CustomerTasks article.
changes: Collapsed the full retained administrative detail surface into explicit secondary tools instead of appending a second profile.
Added parent/branch and actual area subtitle; retained parent navigation and authorized Add branch in secondary tools.
Added a customer-specific posted invoice query helper with complete UTC calendar-month boundaries, a full aggregate and six recent posted invoices.
Replaced limited delivered-order monthly proxy and draft/cancelled order history with accurately labelled posted invoice data.
Corrected acquisition versus registration identity and kept both identities visible when present.
Reused MobileCustomerOverview in commercial CustomerTasks without widening its service scope; unknown totals/balances stay em dashes, with an explicit unavailable-workspace history message.
Added branch locate buttons only for actual saved GPS.
limitations: Commercial fieldCustomers does not return invoices or financial balances; those metrics/history remain explicitly unavailable in that workspace. Adding them requires a separately scoped data contract and is not silently enabled by a design change.
Monthly metric is posted invoice face value for this customer, excluding opening balances. It is labelled Invoiced this month; it is not a commission or net-revenue report.
The reference sample 3.5% commission and branch last-sale dates are not fabricated; current profile payload does not provide them.
Sale, receipt, spoilage and GPS actions retain existing role checks.
screens.sourceComponent: fiche-client.tsx / ClUypg1hpLY; src/views/Customers.jsx; src/components/customers/PartnerDetail.jsx; MobileCustomerOverview.jsx; CustomerTasks.jsx; src/lib/customer-mobile-summary.js

screens.name: Nouveau client
before: For admin/non-commercial phones, MobileCustomerForm has the exported parent/branch selector, identity fields, zone/neighbourhood, GPS, acquisition attribution and sticky save, connected to the existing save handler. But the enclosing CustomerForm always shows the old Details TabsList even for a brand-new customer with only one tab, and edit mode additionally retains the old Add branch and invoice/payment shell. The shared GpsCapture is the full legacy capture/review editor rather than the compact export tile. Most importantly, commercial /customers/new always redirects to CustomerTasks, whose registration is the unchanged FieldCustomerRegistration inside a generic max-h 90dvh dialog, so the exported creation layout is not what a commercial sees.
changes: Removed the lone Details tab in mobile create mode while retaining edit invoice/payment history.
Added compact mobile form header.
Added compact mode to the existing GPS component, retaining capture/watch/stop/discard/accuracy/map/error behavior; no GPS validation was replaced.
Adapted FieldCustomerRegistration phone markup to the exported hierarchy using its current state and checked submit handler.
Commercial attribution remains the actual linked staff/selected review context rather than an unauthorized acquirer selector.
Added data-mobile-action-bar to the full mobile registration CTA bar; existing administrative sticky marker retained.
limitations: Admin and commercial required fields intentionally retain their existing business rules: field registration requires phone and captured GPS; management registration retains its own validation.
No fake Delete action is added to a new unsaved customer. Authorized saved-customer deletion with reason and confirmation is preserved.
Commercial users do not gain admin credit-limit/payment controls or arbitrary acquisition assignment from the visual adaptation.
Authorized editing retains invoice/payment tabs and deletion controls; the reference only specifies creation.

screens.name: Carte clients
before: CustomerMapWorkspace uses real data and a real map, with zone chips and a selected customer/GPS card, but the full route still consists of a generic underlying PageHeader plus CustomerGeoMap opened immediately as a full-screen Dialog. The visible map shell remains the legacy Show pins/Close toolbar, Filters and zones disclosure, edge-to-edge flex map and provider/diagnostic footer. It does not match the export's standalone compact Back/title header, rounded inset map viewport and selected-customer sheet with two equal-width Directions/View profile actions. The current sheet puts Directions on its own primary button and Open customer profile/Delivery details beneath it as outline controls. Commercial mapping explicitly omits onOpenCustomer, so that role never sees the design's View profile action.
changes: Added pageLayout mobile variant to CustomerGeoMap and made initialExpanded false only on phones; desktop/full map behavior remains.
Used an inset rounded viewport with bounded mobile height and a compact selected-customer card.
Added two-column Directions/View profile action row and retained delivery editing in a disclosure.
Moved full zone/filter/provider toolbar into explicit secondary tools while preserving real handlers, drawing controls, assignment review, route steps, errors and diagnostics.
Wired map profile navigation for the commercial role without changing map/customer backend scopes.
limitations: Production map still requires an authorized Google Maps key/map ID; missing or rejected configuration shows the actual actionable error.
No selected card is fabricated before a user selects a real pin.
The reference static map imagery, invented pins and sample 185000 FCFA card amount are not reproduced; the current map point payload does not contain that financial amount.
Directions may open full map intentionally to provide room for live route guidance; returning closes that expanded view to the inline map.

screens.name: Dégustations et échanges
before: Confirmed matches: marketing-cost explanation, two totals, All/Tasting/Exchange segmented counts, functional month/customer filters, real combined history, two fixed entry buttons. Confirmed mismatches: parent Sales.jsx legacy PageHeader adds New sale and a generic Sales-menu back action, with no selected-month subtitle beneath the screen title. Reference history uses separate rounded cards with text badges; implementation groups rows inside one divided container, puts large generic Gift/Rotate icons at left and uses type as heading rather than compact badge. Summary uses white rather than the neutral secondary panel (white theme itself is intentional). Extra Employee filter/profile sentence appears. Footer action emphasis is reversed: Dégustation primary and Exchange outline, whereas reference has Dégustation outline/Exchange primary. Both 48px actions remain above global nav rather than full-bottom 56px actions. Exchange opens generic /sales/new customer step without a replacement-only preset. History covers a single selected employee, whereas reference shows multiple employees in one unscoped month view.
changes: Removed legacy parent PageHeader/New-sale toolbar from phone history; added local back/title/real month-and-year header.
Restored separate rounded history cards with compact type badges, real customer/quantity/date/employee and cost where permitted.
Restored outline Dégustation and primary Exchange 56px action emphasis.
Exchange deep-links to /sales/new?purpose=exchange, opening existing replacement tab after customer selection, without bypassing required evidence or inventing a new transaction mode.

GM All employees history now combines verified Dégustation records and permitted exchanges for the month, with employee/customer filters. Restricted staff remain scoped to their profile with cost redaction. All employees view is read-only and does not pass history filters to entry forms.
limitations: Historical replacement costs or employee attribution can be missing and remain explicitly unknown.
Filter choices are capped at 500 per list with an explicit notice; history records are not silently truncated. The aggregate read accepts at most 366 days.
Existing Dégustation entry remains a separate checked form with stock/source/reason, recording-employee selection and retry protection.

screens.name: Stock
before: QdPSfXOAl6y v3 / stock.tsx: phone stock already used compact rows but lacked the reference family/size grouping and recorded prices; reference cards used 22px geometry. Stock editing opened the embedded legacy editor, bypassing the new item-details screen.
changes: Grouped the real visible rows by family and size and displayed recorded cost/selling prices without inserting sample values.
Applied 22px geometry to stock groups, fabrication entry and inventory metrics.
Phone Edit item details now navigates to /items/:id; desktop retains the embedded editor.
Preserved white SOEICAM branding, removed row Receive/Count controls, the Accounting adjustment destination and central manual Issue goods.

Rows show nearest recorded expiry from existing positive physical-batch balances, flag expired/unknown finished-product dates and omit expiry warnings for packaging. No extra query or per-product Receive/Count action is added.
limitations: Physical on-hand and expiry evidence do not establish saleability or quality release.
Undated material batches remain quiet; finished products distinguish unknown dates. Exhausted batches do not revive historical expiry dates.
Reference sample counts, products and figures are replaced with the live permitted catalogue.

screens.name: Fiche article
before: da9a8WPBrLP v1 / fiche-article.tsx: mobile detail existed only on a direct nonembedded item route; Stock opened the embedded full editor. The route retained the generic item-setup subtitle and appended visible catalogue deletion controls after the mobile pricing actions.
changes: Connected Stock phone editing to the actual item-details route.
Changed the focused phone subtitle to item details/pricing and collapsed catalogue maintenance into an explicit disclosure.
Applied 22px cards to product/pricing/lot/history sections and added a sticky mobile price-action bar.
Retained All item settings, price-save handler, unit correction confirmation, item restoration/removal permissions and history.
limitations: Assembly component cost remains calculated; it is not an editable purchase-price sample.
Nonassembly selling price stays disabled because the existing save workflow does not persist that field for those item types.
The actual stock unit and available item metadata are displayed; carton-pack examples are not fabricated.

screens.name: Réception stock
before: Actual receipt requires an approved order and displays outstanding lines, whereas reference allows no linked order and chooses category/article.
Actual warehouse selector follows permitted storage rules, rather than a fixed Yaoundé destination.
changes: Receipt now uses full-screen phone back/order header, scroll-safe body and persistent 56px Confirm receipt footer, preserving desktop dialog.
Receipt quantity/batch/expiry/valuation fields remain real, packaging omits expiry, and finished goods retain Cold Room restrictions.
limitations: Standalone no-order receipt/category/article picker is unsupported by the checked receiveSupplierOrder operation, so the receipt stays linked to an approved order.
Warehouse cannot be fixed to a sample destination; finished goods retain Cold Room checks.
Outstanding approved-order lines use real decimal quantity inputs instead of the source single-item category/article stepper.

screens.name: Inventaire et ajustement
before: ADNgoZUrngz v1 / inventaire-et-ajustement.tsx: the reference count card was inside a large multi-item modal, preceded by warehouse/search/category/sort controls; the parent route used its legacy audit header and action cluster.
changes: Added the focused phone Quantity adjustments / Inventory count review heading with secondary destinations in Tools.
Moved count selection/warehouse/search/group/sort/refresh controls into Count tools on phones while leaving them open on desktop.
Presented real per-item book/count/difference metrics in 22px cards; preserved explicit per-batch correction and valuation evidence.
Kept Accounting as the quantity-adjustment entry point and preserved product deep links without reintroducing Stock row Count actions.

Counts now require explicit operating vs opening-stock correction treatment. Confirmed setup corrections use reviewed equity with no P&L effect; genuine operating differences retain loss/surplus accounts. Approval binds the selected treatment to its financial plan.
limitations: The checked workflow intentionally retains separate count and accounting-review stages, reference/reason inputs, batch reconciliation, scope limits and atomic journal posting; the reference single-screen confirm sample is adapted.
The landing also exposes the immutable history and audit workbench; a product query opens the focused item count modal.
Previously posted setup mistakes require review in the existing setup correction tool. No automatic historical reclassification or hidden operating losses/gains.

screens.name: Alertes péremption
before: Z3t2NfycKxc v2 / alertes-péremption.tsx: real alias navigation rendered the Manufacturing heading/section bar plus Quality tabs/description ahead of the mobile alerts. Expiry day controls and supplied-batch tools also preceded the reference filters/cards.
changes: Removed the duplicate phone Manufacturing wrapper heading and moved manufacturing destinations to Tools.
Moved the actual QualityControl wrapper tabs/description to a secondary Quality & batches disclosure.
Rendered a focused Stock alerts heading and the real alert chips/cards first.
Moved day-window controls to Risk window and supplied-batch review below the mobile alert cards; applied 22px cards.
limitations: Low stock opens the existing dedicated stock-alert screen rather than merging a different inventory dataset into expiry results.
The Recover action remains in the existing separate recovery workflow; no unchecked disposal/recovery shortcut was invented.
Held/rejected stock filters and supplied-customer history are retained as additional live ERP capabilities.

screens.name: Assemblages
before: cypd2lJUSQx v1 / assemblages.tsx: the catalogue itself matched type/size grouping, but the actual route prepended a generic Production header and four-button section bar before its own Assemblies heading.
changes: Rendered one focused Assemblies heading on phones.
Moved all existing manufacturing section destinations into explicit Tools, preserving production orders, grouped builds, recipes and quality access.
Retained real catalogue grouping, expected bucket yields, component counts, search and authorized New Recipe access.
Applied the reference 22px geometry to assembly groups.
Recipe setup/version navigation is removed per user instruction. Assemblies and their existing product/component editor remain.
limitations: Only active permitted assembly/finished-product records are shown; sample flavours, names and yields are not forced onto real data.
Recipe/version editing remains available through the existing separate recipe workflow.
Historical recipe data is retained; retired recipe URLs redirect to the assembly catalogue.

screens.name: Fiche assemblage
before: vqNDETwOYEj v1 / fiche-assemblage.tsx: the assembly detail was also preceded by the generic Production wrapper and section bar; cards used 12px geometry and its Edit/Produce controls remained ordinary end-of-page actions.
changes: Removed the duplicate phone route wrapper, retained the back destination and used a single product h1.
Applied 22px geometry to product, yield/cost, materials and packaging cards.
Added a sticky Edit/Produce action bar with the existing role restrictions and correct preselected grouped-build route.
Kept real per-bucket material quantities and per-unit packaging based on the saved assembly definition.

Added explicit materials/other-component totals and packaging totals on their labelled per-unit/per-bucket basis, using existing cost resolution, conversions and manual overrides. Added the saved yield helper.
The product assembly definition remains editable without the retired separate recipe workflow.
limitations: Missing component costs and unrecorded/invalid bucket yield remain unknown rather than zero.
Services, asset allocations and other components remain visible under accurate materials-and-other-components labels. Complete assembly cost includes all configured components.
Assembly building still requires valid configured components, costs and stock.

screens.name: Enregistrer production
before: 0YK5dS4gVvA v2 / enregistrer-production.tsx: the grouped entry was behind the generic Production header and section bar; its next step rendered an old long six-column component table whose phone card transformation lacked quantity labels.
changes: Added a focused Record production / Review components and build phone heading with manufacturing tools secondary.
Kept grouped assembly date/responsible/bucket/unit/expiry selection connected to the existing checked preview and posting handlers.
Replaced the phone component table with named, labeled cards for required, on-hand, buildable, after-build, shortages and per-location/lot evidence.
Applied 22px entry/review card geometry and sticky review/build controls while preserving desktop presentation.
Build assemblies is the primary new-production action; Batches & expiry is primary tracking. Existing production history and quality controls remain secondary.
limitations: Batch IDs are generated by the server when production saves; a user-entered reference batch field is intentionally not presented as supported.
A component-check/review step, stale-stock handling, overhead allocation where applicable, retry identity and posting locks remain required.
The legacy /manufacturing/new order workflow remains available separately; grouped-build links target section=build.
Checked component review and atomic stock/accounting posting remain required; no historical records are deleted.

screens.name: Lot production
before: gAyuaIJ7ydY v2 / lot-production.tsx: direct build details only used the mobile lot screen after trace success and silently reverted to the legacy table on a failed read. Alias trace routes also retained QualityControl tabs/description before the mobile screen.
changes: Kept build details in the mobile batch layout during loading/error, showed unknown on-hand as unknown and added an explicit retry.
Moved the real redirected route Quality tabs/description to secondary tools.
Applied 22px batch/product, movement and ingredient cards and retained full production/customer/location details in a disclosure.
Rendered chronological movements, type-appropriate icons, signed quantities for known inbound/outbound movement types and an explicit expired-stock saleability notice.
Preserved full trace warnings and added missing labels to the advanced consumed-material table.
limitations: Directions are shown only when the recorded movement type determines inbound/outbound; ambiguous adjustment/transfer quantities are not given invented signs.
Employee attribution, dates and quantities depend on recorded source data; absent history is not replaced with design samples.
Legacy nonassembly production orders retain their existing specialized order workflow.

screens.name: Comptabilité
before: The dedicated phone home already had the source summary and three-column quick-access structure, but its heading omitted the source Back button and month chip.
Extra ERP entries and the user-requested Quantity adjustments tile made the tile count differ from the six static source tiles.
The To review list used recurring charges only rather than the source mixture of recurring charges and cash to confirm.
changes: Matched header order: Back to dashboard, Accounting and actual month, month/refresh chip.
Kept the existing real posted-ledger profit and authoritative treasury/payable/receivable summary.
Preserved all quick links and the exact existing canAdjustInventory permission gate on Quantity adjustments.
Added actual cash-awaiting-confirmation rows from a lightweight read under the existing Cashier authority, alongside recurring-charge review. Links open the existing checked Caisse workflow.
limitations: General Accounting access alone does not grant access to cash confirmations. Read-only previews skip these reads.
The quick-access grid retains additional ERP features and may exceed six tiles. Posted journals, saved module grants and live records determine contents.
White SOEICAM surfaces and green accents intentionally replace the cream source palette.

screens.name: Nouvelle dépense
before: Mobile fullscreen form already existed, but used a generic modal title without the source Back/subtitle header.
Long workflow guidance preceded the first field; payment status was a standalone Paid badge and recurring navigation used unrelated bottom buttons.
The existing financial operation records small paid petty-cash expenses only, while the reference combines paid/unpaid, bank payments and recurrence in one form.
changes: Added Back, New expense and Recorded once header.
Matched field order: expense account, amount/date, payee, receipt reference, then required description.
Restyled payment status into two segments: Paid and a real Expense request navigation action; kept the checked petty-cash account selector.
Added a source-shaped recurring navigation row, kept cost centre/type controls behind a disclosure, and retained the sticky save/cancel actions.
limitations: This is intentionally not a unified bank/unpaid expense writer. The checked recordExpense handler, petty-cash limit and eligible account restrictions are preserved. Unpaid/planned charges navigate to the existing request or recurring-charge workflows.
The recurring row opens the real recurring workflow; it is not a fake recurrence toggle. Supplier/payee remains the existing text field.
Existing extra required business fields remain. Desktop and payment handlers are unchanged.

screens.name: Charges récurrentes
before: The source two-value summary was followed by a duplicate pending-total panel and a permanently expanded search/status toolbar.
Rows retained the old left calendar icon, supplier-first metadata and desktop amount/status sequence before the added mobile action pair.
The initial pending-only filter hid already-accrued unpaid charges visible in the reference.
changes: Added compact Back/title/subtitle header; Refresh and expense-account tools moved into the header menu.
Kept one two-value summary and moved search, historical status filtering and recognition guidance into Search & filters.
Phone landing now defaults to actual current-month and unpaid charges.
Rebuilt mobile cards in source order: account/due/monthly amount, status, actual period/supplier/balance, Accrue and Pay actions. Existing ChargeDialog callbacks and authorization remain.
limitations: The second summary is all actual accrued unpaid charges, not an invented rent-only arrears total.
The current checked workflow supports pay-now recognition, partial payments and pending payment processing; button guards preserve those semantics rather than copying static source disabled states.
History and all other statuses remain available in filters.

screens.name: Plan comptable
before: The route rendered the old action-heavy Accounting PageHeader, workspace menus and five accounting tabs before the hierarchy.
The chart also placed T-view/list/refresh buttons ahead of the tree.
Each mobile account row had permanent balance metadata and an additional Account actions disclosure row. The selected-account editor opened as a modal rather than below the tree.
changes: Added compact Back/title/Accounts and hierarchy route header, with all ERP navigation in More.
Kept search/new/filter access compact; T-view and refresh live in filters rather than above the hierarchy.

Changed the actual hierarchy into one bordered list of compact indented account rows. Selection highlights the selected row. Row menus preserve balances, subaccount, visibility, activation and checked deletion actions.

The existing AccountFormDialog now supports an inline phone editor below the tree: code/name, parent, checked opening controls, optional Account configuration, sticky Cancel/Save. It scrolls into view after selection and retains every save/validation/locking handler.
limitations: No sample account is selected by default. Actual account types, hierarchy and record permissions determine the tree and editable fields.
Hide remains in the account row menu; the inline footer uses Cancel/Save to preserve explicit draft cancellation.
Opening balances retain the real one-time confirmation and reconciliation workflow rather than presenting editable sample balances as ordinary account settings.

screens.name: Journal comptable
before: The Accounting route shell, journal KPI/statistics, refresh toolbar, filters and exports all preceded the recent-entry list.
A New Journal control navigated to a separate form; the source inline composer was absent from the landing page.
The separate form used the desktop multi-column journal table converted into generic mobile cards.
changes: Added compact journal route header with preserved workspace actions in More.
Mobile landing order is source filters, search and optional detailed filters, Recent entries list, then inline New Journal Entry.
Journal statistics, refresh, integrity review, audit activity and complete exports moved below the main layout into Journal controls & export. Errors stay visible.

Reused the existing JournalEntryForm as an embedded composer with real account picker, date/description, compact account/debit/credit rows, optional line details, Add Line, actual totals, balance validation, draft save and post actions. Successful saves refresh the list; read-only roles do not receive the composer.
Desktop form/register and all checked posting, draft deletion, reversal and idempotency handlers remain.
Unposted manual drafts can be edited through a checked save. Posted manual journals have a linked correction workflow; source-generated journals direct correction to the original operation.
limitations: Source chips use actual ERP source modules rather than invented VT/CA/BQ/OD/AC journal-code categories. Manual journals retain the real manual source.
The existing default register covers all periods; source samples show one month. Actual date filters remain available.
Existing source detail metadata and checked reversal/delete controls add content absent from the static source.
Posted originals retain their history; sales and other source corrections keep their document, stock, cash and period restrictions.

screens.name: Rapports financiers
before: The compact summary existed but was surrounded by the old PageHeader, expanded date toolbar and depreciation panel.
Report exports preceded the statement; the P&L body retained multiple widely spaced desktop account sections, operating totals, empty other sections and source controls.
changes: Added source header with Back, SOEICAM/actual month and working export-scroll action.
Phone P&L defaults to the current month; collapsed range control precedes a three-way report segment. Desktop keeps its prior date default and controls.

Kept actual net/revenue/gross-margin summary; replaced the mobile P&L body with a single bordered compact row list of real revenue, COGS, gross profit, actual expense accounts, totals, optional other income/expense and net.

PDF/Excel exports are below the statement in a two-button row. Detailed revenue/COGS, source corrections and depreciation controls stay available in disclosures. Visible review flags preserve unresolved depreciation warnings.
Balance-sheet and cash-flow exports remain available and have export-scroll targets. Report calculations, refresh-before-export, depreciation checks and source correction logic are unchanged.

Account rows now open reconciled, read-only journal detail by tap/click, keyboard or double-click. P&L, balance-sheet opening/current effects and cash-flow allocations keep their exact date/sign basis.
limitations: Expense rows use authoritative posted account classifications, not the source sample salaries/rent/marketing amounts. Depreciation is not guessed from account names or double-subtracted.
The reference supplies the P&L tab only. Existing balance sheet and detailed cash-flow/history layouts remain established ERP layouts rather than claiming an unseen source layout.
Validation and recurring/depreciation review notices can add visible rows when actual records need review.
Cash-flow component opening/closing names without per-account source lines remain summary values; category/account allocation rows drill down.

screens.name: Immobilisations
before: The route still rendered the old action-heavy PageHeader, DepreciationStatus, four KPI cards and three tabs before the new mobile asset card.
DataTable search, sorting/export controls and card metadata/actions added a second desktop-oriented layer before and within the list.
This was a genuine layout mismatch despite the presence of MobileAssetCard.
changes: Dedicated phone branch now bypasses the old landing shell: compact Back/title/register-date header, one 2x2 summary panel, Assets heading, compact asset cards, then New asset.
Summary follows source order: acquisition cost/net value above accumulated depreciation/monthly charge.

Cards follow source order: name and category/location/date, real status/method badge, cost/duration/monthly charge, actual depreciation progress, accumulated value and NBV. Extra serial/schedule/disposal actions are behind Asset details & actions.
Real search, category and status filters are available from the Assets heading/header. Default current assets exclude disposed/written-off entries; All assets and status filters retain their history.

Header More preserves Register tools & export with the existing DataTable search/sort/export, depreciation history, replacement funding/transfers, depreciation controls, run depreciation and refresh. All existing dialogs and permission gates remain.
A compact visible depreciation-review flag opens the existing detailed issues when relevant; desktop layout and business operations are unchanged.
limitations: The reference near-end badge is not copied as a fabricated financial rule; actual active/fully-depreciated/disposed/written-off state and straight-line method are displayed.
Search/category/status and preservation menus are additional useful ERP controls absent from the static source.
Source cream effects are replaced with the requested white SOEICAM theme and green accents. Live registration/depreciation/disposal/funding writes were not run during this layout audit.

screens.name: Achats
before: Header lacked reference back control.
Third metric showed all posted supplier payments instead of advances.
Different module icons and icon sizes.
Order status was below title rather than upper-right; chevron and missing Order total label changed row hierarchy.
CTA was 48px rather than reference 56px.
Received/billed orders with unpaid bills were missing from open-work list.
changes: Implemented reference header, three-column summary, four 96px module buttons with 44px icons, top-right status cards, total footer, 56px primary CTA.
Advances metric now includes only posted order payments without a bill_id, labelled gross advances paid.
Outstanding bills keep associated received/billed orders in open-work list.
Root /purchases navigation confirmed via sidebar and GM module; existing filters and desktop route handling retained.
limitations: White branding intentionally overrides original cream design.
KPI advances paid is gross posted order advances, not a claimed unapplied credit balance.
Global phone layout gate is <=639px; >=640px uses desktop menu.
Role-scoped module access can reduce the four-module layout.
Global ERP logo/header and bottom navigation remain around design content.

screens.name: Commande fournisseur
before: Order modal had line cards but no advance/received-value summary.
Lifecycle ended at Billed rather than the design Paid stage.
Reference inline receiving block instead opened a separate receiving dialog.
changes: Lifecycle now uses Ordered / Received or Partially received / Paid, with Paid based on posted order-payment totals.
Added actual gross advance-paid and received-value summaries for authorized finance roles.
Optional read-only supplier finance request failure does not block viewing order details.
Mobile order detail and order creation now use full-screen 48px back header, scrolling body and 56px checked primary-action footer; desktop modal is retained.
Supplier/date moved into phone header; progress is first, item rows grouped with dividers, and print/email/refusal/history placed in collapsed Order tools.
limitations: Receiving remains a separate checked form rather than inline partial receipt within order detail.
Unapplied/allocated advance breakdown and Add advance operation are not inferred.
Finance figures are unavailable to roles that cannot read supplier finance.
ERP supplier-catalogue creation/approval fields remain in the order form; source design is primarily an existing-order receipt/detail screen.

screens.name: Fournisseur et règlement
before: Live layout includes a contact/actions card and horizontal detail tabs not present in reference.
Settlement form opens separately; reference shows inline settlement beneath bill/advance timeline.
Credit summary is net ledger credit, not gross available advances.
changes: Mobile supplier profile now uses one back/name/category header; refresh/new supplier/report selection are in an explicit overflow panel.
Contact/terms and purchase/receive/pay shortcuts remain available in a collapsed secondary section; the horizontal phone tabs are removed.

Verified supplier ledger credit, bill balances, actual payment history and all checked authorization/release controls remain.

limitations: Direct advance allocation is unsupported; historical gross advance payments are not presented as available unapplied credit.
Supplier payment requests retain the existing authorization/release workflow and focused form.
The timeline uses recorded document dates/current statuses, not invented historical status-transition times.

screens.name: Caisse
before: Actual cash desk shows pending deposit cards and petty cash, but amount/variance confirmation is in a separate checked dialog.
Header includes existing date/receive controls and extra cash-desk sections.
changes: One 48px back/title/date header replaces the separate date toolbar; date picker and refresh remain reachable in explicit Cash desk tools.
The top Receive cash and Petty cash actions are retained per user override. Savings/payments/invoices/cheques are grouped under More cash desk tools.
Actual pending receipt/petty-cash cards and all treasury/account/variance validation remain in existing CashActionDialog.
CashierHome render callback also receives loading/error/onDate so the separate staff-home screen can retain date/error controls.

Commercial handover/daily-cash cards now embed the same checked confirmation form, with Expected/Received/Variance, required treasury/date, shortfall explanation and retained retry identity. Read-only/disputed guards remain.
limitations: Top Receive cash/Petty cash actions remain per user override.
Customer/staff receipt approvals retain their existing dialogs; inline confirmation covers handovers and daily cash.
Required operational fields add content beyond the static reference. Additional savings/payment/invoice/cheque tools remain reachable.

screens.name: Équipe et profil

before: Team landed on a grouped role directory, requiring a role drawer before reaching an employee profile.
Mobile profile was partial: customer-count progress mislabeled as sales progress, customer rows showed net sales instead of commission, no separate call control and status was not account-aware.
changes: Searchable direct mobile employee roster; each real employee row opens /employees/:id. Role directory/editor, employee editor, removed staff and all Team sections remain available.
Source back/title/profile header, 64px initials, name/role/department/hired date, real employment and login status row, telephone/email rows and separate 48px call action.

Commercial month selector reads existing customerCommissions and companySales APIs, scopes exact employee id, uses approved-supply total against actual monthly_supply_target, and omits progress when no target exists.

Customer rows now display eligible net-sales basis and exact-decimal commission estimates; authoritative estimated_total and bonus remain from the existing monthly report. Unconfigured/failed readers show unavailable states.
56px payslip workspace link and 48px existing Edit employee action; all prior employment records remain in an accessible disclosure.
limitations: Account appearance is read-only and distinguishes employment from login state; the existing employee editor controls changes. No invented active account or unchecked account toggle.
Actual configured target is approved supplies including tax, not a fabricated general sales target; labels state this explicitly.
Commission API basis is eligible net sales, not the source illustration’s paid-base wording; estimates still require management review.
Payslip link opens the existing employee-filtered payroll workspace; its current period picker selects the month rather than claiming an exact source payslip exists.
Performance/commission panels are shown for Commercial employees; unrelated employee roles do not get invented sales metrics.

screens.name: Paie
before: Summary showed Outstanding in place of design Adjustments.

changes: Summary now shows actual aggregate net change from requested base beside total net and review count.

limitations: Payroll uses existing GM per-payslip review and approval/payable workflow; no unsupported Submit to GM operation invented.
Reference generic Add adjustment footer remains individual per-payslip Review actions.
Review/payment histories remain actual stored events; sample event text is not reproduced.
Review/payment dialogs retain the existing detailed payroll field layout; this pass aligned the payroll landing composition.

Role module indicators are read-only summaries; permission writes use the existing reviewed role editor.
